race.comment: ILOVEDIAMONDS (3) is flying of late, winning three in a row prior to last start at this track and trip when just finding one better under 61kg. Up slightly in grade but gets the relative weight relief and the stable/jockey combination do very well together. SKJALDMO (10) was a smart maiden winner fresh then held her ground in a dash home at Seymour. Can improve again and take beating. BEL LUPA (12) is racing well without winning, finding the line strongly at Pakenham last start. Likely gets back for Shinn but will be rattling home. JUST THINK TWICE (4) resumes having won his only start last campaign. May have had a couple of issues but is lightly raced and can win this.
